about: Filtered lens on France for freebie hunting: small hosting providers (hebergeurs) announce trials on their own sites and Discord servers; the precision marker for a claimable no-card trial is 'sans CB'. There is no feedable French freebie board; the machine layer is thin and the community layer carries the depth.

feeds.name: Korben
feeds.notes: France's largest tech discovery blog for web tools and services; free tools and SaaS coverage is routine (8 of the 23 most recent items mention 'gratuit', checked 2026-11-12). Firehose: read on wake, never a trigger.

feeds.name: Sebsauvage, Liens en vrac
feeds.notes: One-curator link blog running for decades. Low freebie density (about 4 explicit free-service signals in 50 items, checked 2026-11-12) but high curation quality, occasionally exactly on category (for example free DDNS services). Firehose.

hunting_grounds.how: The habitat of small French hebergeurs: they announce free tiers and trials inside their Discord servers, and the listing is the discovery door. Read the listing, open newly surfaced hosts, and verify any offer at the host's own site before reporting it. The listing page is JavaScript-rendered, so the runner cannot diff it; this ground belongs to the agent leg (browser or search), exactly like the main registry's non-pullable sources. Spotted there while scouting (2026-11-12): Zira Hosting advertising free offers, PixelHorizons 100% free community hosting.

hunting_grounds.how: Community project that creates free dedicated game servers on machines in France, no subscription and no card, requests by a short form read by humans. Small and games-specific; watch its game pages for new titles.
hunting_grounds.name: TeamKit

hunting_grounds.how: Catalogue of France's alternative and associative hosting collective. Harvest the member host list once, then watch the members' own sites for new free services and trials.

local_patterns: Small hebergeurs announce trials on their own sites and Discord servers; DISBOARD (tag vps, French filter) is the discovery door, not a forum feed.
'sans CB' and 'sans carte bancaire' in an offer headline mark a trial that passes a no-card owner filter; treat them as precision boosters in any search.
A source dominated by 'échantillons gratuits' (consumer product samples) is retail class, not a freebie source.
